/-!
# Erdős Problem 547

*References:*
- [erdosproblems.com/547](https://www.erdosproblems.com/547)
- [Bu74] Burr, S. A., Generalized Ramsey theory for graphs—a survey. Graphs and combinatorics
  (Proc. Capital Conf., George Washington Univ., Washington, D.C., 1973) (1974), 52-75.
- [Zh11] Zhao, Y., Proof of the $(n/2-n/2-n/2)$ conjecture for large $n$.
  Electron. J. Combin. (2011), Paper 27, 61.
-/

open Filter

namespace Erdos547

/--
If $T$ is a tree on $n$ vertices then
$$R(T) \leq 2n-2.$$

This problem is #14 in Ramsey Theory in the graphs problem collection.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 5]
theorem erdos_547 :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (T : SimpleGraph (Fin n)),
      T.IsTree → SimpleGraph.diagonalGraphRamsey T ≤ 2 * n - 2 := by
  sorry

/--
For sufficiently large $n$, every tree $T$ on $n$ vertices satisfies $R(T)\leq 2n-2$.
Proved by Zhao [Zh11].
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem erdos_547.variants.sufficiently_large :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, ∀ T : SimpleGraph (Fin n),
      T.IsTree → SimpleGraph.diagonalGraphRamsey T ≤ 2 * n - 2 := by
  sorry

end Erdos547

review.notes:
Both declarations faithfully state their sources. Zhao’s Corollary 2.2 gives the bound for all sufficiently large n, not merely even n; the paper’s parity discussion concerns a stronger conjecture. The source catalogue’s status ‘decidable’ means unresolved up to a finite check, so `research open` remains appropriate for the main theorem.

Independent checks in /workspace/review/scratch.lean compile without sorry dependencies. They establish nonemptiness of the Ramsey-number defining set, invariance under graph isomorphism, equivalence of the eventual statement to a uniform threshold, satisfiability of the tree hypothesis at every permitted order, R(K₁)=1, and Ramsey number 2 for every two-vertex graph. Thus the n ≥ 2 restriction is appropriate and the natural-number infimum introduces no default-value defect.

The live Erdős page was blocked by Cloudflare; its archived page was checked alongside current catalogue metadata. Only the preview of Burr’s survey was accessible, but the exact problem and variant were independently verified in the original graph collection and Zhao’s paper. The reviewed file is unchanged.
